focal_point: An aerial of a whole roof, with an offer tile as the second shape. The roof is larger; the tile is the message.
eye_path: Diagonal along the roof into the tile and the phone.
grid: Full-bleed aerial plus a corner or band tile. One break where the tile sits.
scale_ratios: The tile numeral is strong and still not a clean 1.6× over the headline. Closer than the rest of this series.
type_choices: Heavy grotesque in the tile, smaller headline. About four sizes.
photo_art_direction: Aerial roof plane, useful crop for a trade you cannot see from the curb. Vendor lighting, clean.
offer_placement: Tile on a quieter area. This is the pattern to steal as a principle: one first-step figure on the photo.
trust_and_cta: Phone with the tile. Local claims stay on the card and are not ours.

hierarchy.reason: Numeral is large, not quite isolated.

trust.reason: Proof is the roof, not badges.

glance_3s.reason: Glance gets a roof and a free step.

emulate: Aerial or high angle of the actual roof plane, one offer tile on the quiet part, phone in that tile.
do_not_copy: The contractor mark, phone, headlines, and the vendor's repeated yellow-or-red tile system. Style reference only. This series shares one house style, so repetition is not independent proof.
anti_patterns: Copying the tile chrome instead of the structure.
summary: Best of the shared roofing series. Style reference only. One roof, one first step. Still a B+ because the tile system is template grammar.
